Two failed parent-rebind receipts (`precommit` and `preintegration`) are preserved, and distinct `preintegration-v2` receipt reproduces as passed via `ariadne_orchestrator_preflight.py`.
14. **Protected boundaries**: Verified. No applied migration, operational database, watcher/feed, application, API/Diary wiring, provider, patient/clinical/product data, command/write, deployment, Pages or protected-ref boundary opens.
